items.title: GalaxyChat App
items.description: Real-time messaging platform with end-to-end encryption, custom themes, and 10k+ active users.

caseStudy.overview: GalaxyChat was born out of a need for a privacy-first messaging platform that doesn't compromise on design.
caseStudy.problem: Existing chat apps either prioritised security at the expense of UX, or offered great design without meaningful privacy guarantees.
caseStudy.solution: Built a WebSocket-powered real-time engine with end-to-end encryption on the client side using the Web Crypto API.
caseStudy.challenges: The hardest part was implementing real-time read receipts at scale without hammering the database. Solved with Redis pub/sub for in-flight events.
caseStudy.outcome: Launched to 10k+ users in the first month. Average session time is 18 minutes — 3x the industry average.

items.title: FinTrack Dashboard
items.description: Personal finance tracker with AI-powered insights, beautiful charts, and multi-currency support.

caseStudy.overview: FinTrack started as a personal side project — I was frustrated with bloated finance apps and wanted something minimal, fast, and smart.
caseStudy.problem: Most finance trackers are overwhelming. Too many features, too many categories, and zero actionable insights.
caseStudy.solution: Designed a clean dashboard with a 3-metric focus: net worth, monthly delta, and savings rate. Integrated GPT-4 to surface one weekly insight in plain English.
caseStudy.challenges: Multi-currency real-time conversion without paid APIs. Solved by caching ECB rates hourly and computing conversions client-side.
caseStudy.outcome: Used daily by 200+ beta users. Average user reduces unnecessary subscriptions by 3,500/month after 30 days.

items.title: ShopVerse E-commerce
items.description: Full-featured e-commerce platform with inventory management, analytics, and Stripe integration.

caseStudy.overview: ShopVerse was commissioned by a local retailer looking to migrate from a legacy system to a modern, self-hosted platform they could actually own.
caseStudy.problem: The client was paying high SaaS fees and had zero control over their data or checkout flow.
caseStudy.solution: Built a Vue 3 + Laravel API stack with a custom admin panel, Stripe Checkout integration, and a Redis-backed inventory reservation system.
caseStudy.challenges: Inventory reservation race conditions under flash sale load. Solved with Redis atomic DECR commands and a queue-based order confirmation flow.
caseStudy.outcome: Reduced checkout abandonment by 40%. Client saved 85k/year vs previous SaaS plan. Handles 500+ daily orders during peak season.
